title: DePass family members
summary: Dave DePass was the clarinet player; half-brothers named Bollier are mentioned before he moves on to Sam Morgan.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Dave DePass you say was the clarinet player?

Clarinet player, yeah. Now his other half brothers was Rudolf Bollier and Octave, Octave, a fair few old people say I pronounce it Octave Bollier. Well after leaving René's band, then I went and played with Sam Morgan's band.
